# A. Nilesh Fernando

A. Nilesh Fernando is an Associate Professor in the Department of Economics at King's Business
School, King's College London. He is an applied microeconomist working on labor and development
economics, with research on labor market information, international migration, agricultural
technology adoption, and discrimination. He is a Faculty Affiliate of J-PAL and an Affiliate of
BREAD.
